title: Example FIFO shipments dead-letter queue triage
prohibitions: Never redrive this queue: the downstream carrier API is not idempotent, so a re-sent shipment event books a second pickup.

cases.description: the shipment reached a terminal state before this event was processed
cases.prose: The shipment entity already shows 'delivered', which is terminal. This dead-lettered event cannot change it, so the message is a safe duplicate.
cases.resolution: Delete the message. The shipment's own state is terminal and already correct.

cases.description: a dispatch event arrived before the shipment was ever packed
cases.prose: The shipment has no 'packed' entry in its history, so this 'shipment.dispatched' event overtook the event that should have preceded it. It would normally be re-inserted to be re-applied in order — but this queue prohibits redrive.
cases.resolution: Re-insert so the event is re-applied once the preceding event has landed.
followUps: Confirm the carrier has not already been notified before replaying this event by hand.

cases.description: a cancellation raced a dispatch that had already completed
cases.prose: The shipment history contains both 'packed' and 'dispatched', so the carrier already has the parcel. A cancellation cannot be applied automatically and needs a human to call the carrier.
cases.resolution: Escalate. The parcel is already with the carrier; cancellation is a manual carrier-side action.
